SUMMARY▴▾

Connor McDavid's salary is $10,000,000 and his cap hit is $12,500,000 for the 2024-25 season. His salary is comprised of $7,000,000 in signing bonuses and $3,000,000 in base salary. He is a 27 year old centre who was born on Jan. 13, 1997. He was drafted 1st overall by the Edmonton Oilers in the 1st round of the 2015 entry draft. He has signed 2 contracts worth a total value of $111,325,000. Over a career that spans 9 seasons (with at least 1 NHL GP), he has a total 982 Pts in 645 GP, and 117 playoffs Pts in 74 GP. He will be a UFA at the end of the 2025-26 season when he is 29 years old.
